assertion.limit_order: Each prime-ideal class has finite order, so a positive power is principal. The valuation image is free of rank |S| and its extension by the unit group splits as abelian groups. assertion.statement: For the fixed imaginary quadratic K and finite set S, class finiteness gives a finite-index valuation image in Z^S; finite cyclic units then give squareclass dimension 1+|S|.

assertion.hypotheses: K is imaginary quadratic; ideal classes are proper invertible classes.
assertion.quantifiers: Every imaginary quadratic field, including Q(i) and Q(sqrt(-3)).
assertion.normalizations: Ordinary integral ideals and ordinary units; exceptional roots of unity are retained.
